reviews.text:
FG Pools LLC recently remodeled our pool with the best materials, workmanship and communication! Francisco and his team are great to work with and always do their best!
Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Ari Ri

reviews.text: I visited with 7 pool companies with good reviews in the Dallas area before doing plaster, tile and coping on my pool.  I highly recommend saving this time as FG Pools LLC delivers far superior workmanship and choices for thousands less.  The work was done in half the time other companies promised despite some weather challenges.  They don't contract the work out so I felt comfortable with the team.  They also didn't charge an upgrade fee for the higher quality products I wanted.  I wanted the upgraded plaster called Stonescapes Small Puerto Rico Blend in Tropics Blue.  The results surpassed my expectations.
reviews.author: Debra Bluestein

reviews.text: I have have seen the amazing design talent and installation of FG Pools firsthand. Their quality craftmanship and attention to details reassure their clients that they made the right decision to hire them. Francisco and Ari are pleasant to work with and have the experience to deliver exactly what you are looking for whether it's a pool or an outdoor living space.
reviews.author: Todd Ramsey

reviews.text: We highly recommend FG pools for a pool remodel. We recently had a complete renovation of our pool - plaster, tile mastic, new equipment and getting pool and spa lights working and replaced and a handrail added for safety. Francisco knows pools and offers suggestions and advice. The entire team was fabulous to work with as well. Great communication throughout the project and the quality of the workmanship was top notch. The job was completed on time and with no issues. If you are looking for a pool company that will do exactly what they say they will, on time and on budget, I highly recommend FG Pools.
reviews.author: Barri Silverberg

reviews.text: Recently I had a pool renovation done by F&G Pools. I have to say I have never worked with a company like F&G that had such high standards from start to finish. The owner was always available throughout the project to answer any questions. I have to say F&G exceeded my expectations on this pool renovation. After interviewing six pool companies with frustration I finally found a company that could do everything I wanted at a reasonable price using quality material. I must add it was difficult finding a company with a 5 star rating that had all good reviews.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.text: For your pool remodels in the DFW area, FG Pools should be on or near the top of your list. FG Pools completely remodeled our old tired pool with Travertine coping tile, Midnight plaster with glass beads, and expanded pool deck.  They handled our late upgrade requests without any problems and communications with Maria and Francisco were always excellent.  Any minor problems or issues were taken care of immediately.
reviews.author: Robert Gee

reviews.text: FG Pools LLC is great!! I got several bids, various companies, for work I needed done on my in-ground pool. FG Pools LLC were by far the best priced, fair, affordable and helpful. ALL of my questions were answered! They helped guide me on picking new tile and plaster. I had a lot of work done pool, lights, deck, etc. and the finished product is stunningly beautiful. I'm so pleased!!! Easy to work with. This is the company you need to use for your pool needs. 5 Giant Stars!! Thank you FG Pools!
reviews.author: Charla Tambourine

reviews.text: We highly recommend FG Pools for a pool remodel.  We recently had a complete renovation of our pool - plaster, tile, coping, stamped and stained concrete, new equipment and new water features.  Everyone we worked with - Francisco, the owner, Maria, the office manager, Andrew, the on-site manager, Alex, the equipment installer, and all the workers and subcontractors they use - were all kind, proficient and hard-working.  Everyone was respectful to our property and cleaned up each day.  We can’t say enough good things about the quality of the workmanship and the smoothness of staying on target with finishing the sizable job in a timely manner.  We could not be more pleased with the finished results, and we are very glad we chose FG Pools over the several others we interviewed.  They truly want the customer to be pleased with the outcome, and I believe they will be just as helpful to work with if we ever encounter a problem.  We would definitely hire them again!
reviews.author: Jenny Riley
